classification.difficultyReason: Find three fractions of a monetary quantity and subtract the total allocated fraction from one.

content.prompt: Alejandro allocates $\frac{1}{4}$ of his pocket money to transport costs, $\frac{1}{10}$ to telephone calls and $\frac{3}{5}$ to clothes, and he saves the rest. If he receives $\$18$ per week, what are his expenses for transport, telephone calls and clothes? What fraction of his pocket money does Alejandro save each week?

answer.short: Transport: $\$4.50$; telephone calls: $\$1.80$; clothes: $\$10.80$. He saves $\frac{1}{20}$ of his pocket money each week.
answer.worked:
The whole is $\$18$ per week. Divide by the denominator to find one part, then multiply by the numerator.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Transport}&=\$18\div4\\\text{Transport}&=\$4.50\\\text{Telephone calls}&=\$18\div10\\\text{Telephone calls}&=\$1.80\\\text{Clothes}&=(\$18\div5)\times3\\\text{Clothes}&=\$10.80\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\text{Fraction saved}&=1-\left(\frac14+\frac1{10}+\frac35\right)\\\text{Fraction saved}&=1-\left(\frac5{20}+\frac2{20}+\frac{12}{20}\right)\\\text{Fraction saved}&=\frac{20}{20}-\frac{19}{20}\\\text{Fraction saved}&=\frac1{20}\end{align*}$$
